title: In severe COVID-19, SARS-CoV-2 induces a chronic, TGF-β-dominated adaptive immune response (Measles-reactive T cells)
description: Single cell transcriptome and TCR sequencing of FACS-sorted Measles-reactive memory T cells of the peripheral blood of a healthy donor Overall design: Sequencing of RNA and TCR was performed from FACS-sorted Measles-reactive memory T cells (CD4+CD45RO+CD154+) from the peripheral blood of 1 healthy donor, using the 10X Genomics platform with the Single Cell 5’ Library & Gel Bead Kit

runs.experiment_title: NextSeq 500 sequencing: GSM4785641: Measles Homo sapiens RNA-Seq
